entities.summary: Alvin Robert Lamar Jones III is a Luxembourgish-American former professional basketball player. A 6-foot-11-inch (2.11 m), 265-pound (120 kg) center, he attended Kathleen High School in Lakeland, Florida, and played collegiately at the Georgia Institute of Technology, where he set the program's all-time record for shots blocked with 425.
